title: Job Roles in the Media Industry (Part 1)

flashcard_questions.q: The three stages of creating a media product: pre-production (planning), production (creating), and post-production (editing and finishing).
The first phase of media production where planning, research, concept development, and design take place before any content is created.
The phase after production where content is edited, refined, and prepared for distribution, including adding effects, titles, and sound.
Which creative role writes engaging text for adverts, websites and marketing materials?
